storyboardBeats.narration: Rattling under the car over every bump?
storyboardBeats.providerScene: POV shot from inside a car driving down a slightly rough residential street, dashboard and hood visible in frame, subtle suspension bounce as the car crosses a bump, warm daylight, 9:16 vertical framing

Low-angle shot underneath a car on a garage lift, exhaust pipe and muffler visible running the length of the underbody, slow push-in dolly toward a rubber hanger bracket, work-light illumination, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Often it's a broken exhaust hanger, the rubber holding your pipe up.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Extreme macro on a rubber exhaust hanger isolator, visible dry-rot cracking, gloved hand (no face) gently flexing it to show the crack widening, bright clinical work-light, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: When it cracks, the pipe swings loose and taps.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Static wide shot of the car underbody on the lift, exhaust pipe hanging with a small amount of visible sag/give but still clear of the road, calm neutral lighting, slight held vibration, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: A light rattle is one clue.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Same underbody framing, now the exhaust pipe visibly sagging lower toward the pavement, color grade shifts warmer/more urgent, slight handheld shake for emphasis, hard cut to a close shot of the tailpipe end nearly touching the ground, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: A loud bang or scraping, pull over.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Technician's gloved hand (no face) running a flashlight beam along the full exhaust system from underneath on a lift, methodical inspection motion, warm garage lighting, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Do not guess. Worth a look underneath.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Wide shot of a tire shop garage bay interior, bay door partially open to daylight, tools racked in the background, no readable signage or branding in frame, warm end-of-day light, static hold — SAVE freeze frame per the render-integrity contract's 3s end-hold convention, 9:16 vertical framing
